doc: Qwen3-VL (Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration), the text stage for text-only prompts: a Qwen3 decoder (per-head q/k norm, head_dim from the config) under `model.language_model.*` with its interleaved M-RoPE, which for a text-only stream is the plain rotary embedding of the position. The tower, the patch merger and the DeepStack mergers (`model.visual.*`) belong to the vision stage; DeepStack's addition of vision features to early layers does not happen without an image. Third-party adapter (lane H).
